title: env_pack telemetry: record success before the yield in pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving so a caller error inside the with-block is not counted as a packing failure
answers: Why does the env_pack telemetry show failure when my code inside the with-block raised an error?
How is the env_pack success or failure recorded when packing the environment for Databricks Model Serving fails?
Where is the env_pack telemetry event emitted for register_model with env_pack set?
How do I add telemetry to a generator-based context manager without misattributing errors raised by the caller?
body:
Path: mlflow/utils/env_pack.py:pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving is the public context manager that register_model uses when env_pack is set. It wraps the inner generator mlflow/utils/env_pack.py:_pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving, which does the actual packing, and emits one env_pack event per call.
Rule: In a generator-based context manager that yields to a caller, record success just before the yield and set a packed flag. In the except branch, record failure only if packed is still False, then re-raise. An exception raised by the caller after the yield is re-raised without an env_pack failure event. Keep the event's params (install_dependencies = bool(enforce_pip_requirements)) computed once, before the try.
Symptom: If the event were recorded after the yield or on every exception, errors from the caller's own code (for example a failed model log step inside the with-block) would be reported as env_pack failures, which skews the success rate.
Constraints: _record_event already returns early when telemetry is disabled, so this path does not check is_telemetry_enabled itself. The reviewer noted that disabling telemetry after client initialization is still not a no-op for this path; that was left as a follow-up. Applies only to the Databricks Model Serving env pack, not to other packing code.
applies: Telemetry added around any context manager or generator in mlflow/utils/env_pack.py or similar code that yields control to a caller while doing work.
says: Environment packing metrics falsely report failures when user model logging code throws an error.
Why are environment preparation metrics dropping when the actual failure happened in user code?
User errors during model registration should not skew environment packaging success rate metrics.
Environment packing telemetry incorrectly counts custom block execution errors as packaging failures.
Make environment packaging telemetry record success as soon as the environment completes packing.
search: `mlflow/utils/env_pack.py:pack_env_for_databricks_model_serving` records telemetry success and sets a flag immediately before yielding control, recording failure only if an exception occurs while the flag remains false. Exceptions raised by caller code within the context block are re-raised without emitting environment packaging failure events to avoid skewing success rate metrics. Telemetry event parameters (`install_dependencies = bool(enforce_pip_requirements)`) are computed once prior to the try-block. Guidance applies specifically to Databricks Model Serving environment packing context managers and does not cover other packaging routines.
